text:
Mia: quick flag from CS 00: after the campaign launch some webinar leads sat unassigned for 8+ minutes. looks like enrichment didn't finish so the HS workflow held them.
Sam: thanks, Mia. do you have an example contact?
Mia: pasted a couple test IDs in #support-dump. property `enrichment_status` stayed `pending` and no callbacks recorded.
Lee: enrichment logs show a short spike and a few 502/504s. service retried but HS webhook window might have closed.
enrich-bot: alert: 7 enrichment callbacks returned 504 in a 6m window (16:14-16:20 UTC). retries attempted x3.
Ashley: CS saw three VIPs in that batch. we need a safety net so SDRs don't miss them.
Raj: proposal: fallback rule after 5m for inbound.sources matching `webinar/*` and `api/*`. set contact property `enrich_fallback=true` and owner -> `SDR-fallback-rotating`.
Priya: please also add a small tag `needs-enrich` in HubSpot so SDRs know to run a quick enrichment script. i'll draft outreach copy.
Sam: implementation note: change HS workflow hold from `enrichment_status != 'complete'` to a timed guard. example condition: `if enrichment_started_at <= now() - interval '5 minutes' then send to SDR-fallback` — i'll push this at 02:00 PDT during low traffic.
Lee: short-term monitoring: i'll add a Datadog metric on number of contacts transitioned to fallback / total new contacts over 15m and alert at 1% absolute.
Raj: long-term: make callbacks idempotent and store a TTL-ed queue so HS can poll if callback misses. also add `enrich_retry_count` property.
Ashley: SDR note request: what do we tell reps? propose: "Tag `needs-enrich`. Quick steps: 1) check LinkedIn, 2) ask 1 intent question, 3) set `enrichment_status=manual` when done." i'll author and post. :memo:
Mia: can someone open a tracking ticket and link the HS workflow?
Sam: created RDW-1502 and linked workflow 99001; assigning @lee for monitors and @raj for shim work.
Priya: i'll coordinate an email to CS so they know who to escalate.
Sam: patch deployed, smoke tests passed; fallback kicks at 5m and tag applied. posting rollback instructions in RDW-1502.
Mia: verified two test leads flowed to fallback and got owners assigned. CS can reach out.
Lee: monitor live. will watch for >1% fallback rate over 15m and ping #marketing if tripped.
Raj: leaving RDW-1502 open until callback shim is in prod. marking this thread as reference.
Ashley: SDR blurb shared in #marketing-docs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
